translations.web: But I tell you, love your enemies, bless those who curse you, do good to those who hate you, and pray for those who mistreat you and persecute you,
translations.bsb: But I tell you, love your enemies and pray for those who persecute you,
translations.kjv: But I say unto you, Love your enemies, bless them that curse you, do good to them that hate you, and pray for them which despitefully use you, and persecute you;
translations.asv: but I say unto you, love your enemies, and pray for them that persecute you;
